messages.content: 誰是英超聯賽中最多助攻的球員？

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

message.content: 截至目前（2025 年），英超歷史上助攻數最多的球員是 **Ryan Giggs**，他在 1990‑2014 期間為曼聯出場 963 場，累計 162 次助攻，保持著英超單一球員助攻紀錄。

The tool provided is sports_analysis_get_top_scorer, which retrieves top scorer, not assists. There's no tool for assists. So we cannot use the tool. We need to answer manually. We can provide the answer: According to data up to 2025, the Premier League all-time assist leader is Ryan Giggs? Actually all-time assists: Ryan Giggs has 162 assists. But the question might be about current season? The user didn't specify season. So likely they want all-time record. The all-time assist record is Ryan Giggs with 162. But also Wayne Rooney had 103.
